metadata.description: Hopper's plugins: LLM, text-to-speech and speech-to-text for voice agents and AI agents.

plugins.name: hopper
plugins.description: LLM, text-to-speech and speech-to-text for voice agents and AI agents: set Hopper up in a voice-agent project, measure time to first token on its own prompt, find what slows it down, and speak or transcribe audio.

plugins.name: hopper-announce
plugins.description: Claude Code says out loud when a long task finishes: one short sentence in a Hopper voice. Speaks only for tasks of 20 seconds or more; adjustable or off with one sentence.
